components.name: method
values: additive baseline | for double perturbation of genes a and b predicts ŷ_add = y_a + y_b - y_ .
cpa v0.8.8 | deep learning model for predicting combinatorial perturbations trained on norman dataset following tutorial.
gears v0.1.2 | deep learning model predicting expression changes after perturbation using gene ontology annotations.
geneformer | fine-tuned on perturbation labels in silico perturbation used to obtain perturbed embedding. linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.
no change baseline | predicts control condition expression for any perturbation.
scbert | fine-tuned on perturbation labels post-perturbation embedding computed similarly to uce. linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.
scfoundation | foundation model fine-tuned for 5 epochs due to 3-day time limit.
scgpt | foundation model fine-tuned following their tutorial for perturbation prediction.
uce four-layer version | zero-shot model post-perturbation embedding computed by overwriting perturbed genes with ground truth values. linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.

components.name: dataset
values: adamson k562 | as provided by gears
replogle k562 | as provided by gears
replogle rpe1 | as provided by gears

components.name: method
values: gears | deep learning model using gene ontology annotations to predict unseen perturbations.
geneformer | fine-tuned on perturbation labels in silico perturbation linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.

linear model lm | represents each read-out gene with k-dimensional vector g and each perturbation with l-dimensional vector p. finds w via ridge regression argmin_w y_train - g w p t + b _2 2 + ridge penalty. g and p derived from pca of training data k=10 λ=0.1.

linear model with pretrained embeddings | same as lm but using pretrained gene embedding g from scfoundation or scgpt or perturbation embedding p from gears spectral embedding of gene ontology matrix or from replogle data 10d pca .
mean baseline | predicts the mean expression across all perturbations in the training set.
scbert | fine-tuned on perturbation labels perturbed embedding via overwriting linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.
scgpt | foundation model fine-tuned per tutorial.
uce four-layer | zero-shot perturbed embedding via overwriting linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.

components.name: result_metric
values: error relative to mean baseline ratio

components.name: task
values: benchmarking models on single perturbation prediction using two crispr interference datasets from replogle et al. 2022 k562 and rpe1 and one from adamson et al. 2016 k562 .
evaluating performance using linear model with gene/perturbation embeddings from pretrained models.
predicting effects of unseen single perturbations using gears simulation test-training splitting procedure repeated twice.
